llms.body:
# IEEE Computer Society

> Engaging computer engineers, scientists, academia, and industry professionals from all areas of computing, the IEEE Computer Society (CS) sets the standard for the education and engagement that fuels continued global technological advancement. Through conferences, publications, and programs, and by bringing together computer science and engineering leaders at every phase of their career for dialogue, debate, and collaboration, IEEE CS empowers, shapes, and guides the future of not only its members, but the greater industry, enabling new opportunities to better serve our world.

Content on this site falls into a few durable groups: membership and professional development; peer-reviewed publications and the Computer Society Digital Library (CSDL); conferences and calls for papers; technical communities and local chapters; volunteering and awards; and organizational information. Conference and call-for-papers pages are dated and are superseded each year.

The Digital Library at https://www.computer.org/csdl is a separate client-rendered application. Its pages are not present in the served HTML, so the publication list below is the reliable index of what it contains. Its URL patterns are: https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/{code} and /csdl/magazine/{code} for a periodical's home page (codes listed below), /csdl/proceedings/{group} for a conference proceedings series, and /csdl/10.1109/{doi-suffix} to resolve an IEEE DOI directly to its article page.

## About

- [About the IEEE Computer Society](https://www.computer.org/about): mission, organizational structure, and what the Society does
- [Vision and commitment](https://www.computer.org/about/vision): strategic direction and stated commitments
- [History](https://www.computer.org/about/cs-history): the Society's founding and development
- [Contact](https://www.computer.org/about/contact): general and departmental contact information
- [Privacy](https://www.computer.org/about/privacy): how the Society handles personal data
- [Accessibility statement](https://www.computer.org/about/accessibility-statement): conformance commitments for this site

## Membership

- [Membership overview](https://www.computer.org/membership): grades, benefits, and eligibility
- [Join](https://www.computer.org/membership/join): application process and current pricing
- [Student membership](https://www.computer.org/membership/for-students): reduced-rate membership and student-specific benefits
- [CS Juniors](https://www.computer.org/membership/juniors): program for pre-university students
- [Distinguished Contributor Recognition Program](https://www.computer.org/membership/distinguished-contributors): recognition for senior practitioners

## Publications

- [Publications overview](https://www.computer.org/publications): the full portfolio of transactions, journals, and magazines
- [Author guidelines](https://www.computer.org/publications/author-resources): how to prepare and submit a manuscript
- [Calls for papers](https://www.computer.org/publications/author-resources/calls-for-papers): open submission calls across all titles and conferences
- [Editor guidelines](https://www.computer.org/publications/editor-resources): guidance for editors-in-chief and guest editors
- [Reviewer guidelines](https://www.computer.org/publications/reviewer-resources): expectations for peer reviewers
- [Peer review schedules](https://www.computer.org/publications/peer-review-schedules): review turnaround targets by title
- [Open access content](https://www.computer.org/publications/open-access-content): open access options and fees
- [IEEE editorial style manual](https://www.computer.org/publications/computer-society-style-guide): editorial and formatting standards
- [ComputingEdge](https://www.computer.org/publications/computing-edge): monthly magazine of selected articles drawn from across the portfolio
- [Tech News](https://www.computer.org/publications/tech-news): practitioner-facing articles, career guidance, and industry commentary

## Digital Library (CSDL)

- [CSDL home](https://www.computer.org/csdl/home): search and browse the full IEEE Computer Society Digital Library
- [Journals index](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journals): all transactions and journals in CSDL
- [Magazines index](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazines): all magazines in CSDL
- [Conference proceedings](https://www.computer.org/csdl/proceedings): proceedings of Society-sponsored conferences
- [Browse by date](https://www.computer.org/csdl/browse-by-date): issues and proceedings by publication date
- [Video library](https://www.computer.org/csdl/video-library): recorded talks and conference video content
- [Institutional subscriptions](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/institutional-subscriptions): licensing for libraries, universities, and companies
- [Librarian resources](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/librarian-resources): getting started, usage statistics, and administration
- [Remote access](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/accessing-the-cs-digital-library-remotely): how subscribers reach CSDL from off-network
- [Trial request](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/trial-request): request an institutional trial
- [Access request](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/access-request): request access to subscribed content
- [Why CSDL](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/choose-the-resource-the-computing-industry-relies-on): scope and coverage of the Digital Library
- [Peer review in CSDL](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/peer-review): how content in the library is reviewed
- [Terms of use](https://www.computer.org/digital-library/terms-of-use): permitted use of Digital Library content

## Transactions and journals

- [IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/tp): computer vision, pattern recognition, and machine learning
- [IEEE Transactions on Computers](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/tc): computer architecture, hardware design, and systems
- [IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/ts): software design, construction, testing, and maintenance
- [IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/tk): databases, data mining, and knowledge representation
- [IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/td): parallel algorithms, distributed systems, and high-performance computing
- [IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/tg): visualization, graphics, virtual and augmented reality
- [IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/tm): mobile and wireless systems, protocols, and applications
- [IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/tq): reliability, fault tolerance, security, and privacy
- [IEEE Transactions on Cloud Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/cc): cloud architecture, virtualization, and services
- [IEEE Transactions on Services Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/sc): service-oriented architecture, web services, and business process integration
- [IEEE Transactions on Big Data](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/bd): large-scale data management, analytics, and infrastructure
- [IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/ta): emotion recognition, sentiment analysis, and human-computer affect
- [IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/ec): new and cross-disciplinary areas of computing
- [IEEE Transactions on Sustainable Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/su): energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable computing
- [IEEE Transactions on Privacy](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/pr): privacy-enhancing technologies, policy, and practice
- [IEEE/ACM Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/bb): computational methods in biology, genomics, and medicine
- [IEEE Computer Architecture Letters](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/ca): short, rapid-turnaround papers on computer architecture
- [IEEE Open Journal of the Computer Society](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/oj): fully open access journal spanning the Society's technical scope

## Magazines

- [Computer](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/co): the Society's general-interest magazine, covering computing broadly for practitioners
- [IEEE Software](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/so): software development practice, process, and engineering management
- [IEEE Security & Privacy](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/sp): security engineering, cryptography in practice, and privacy
- [IEEE Micro](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/mi): chip and system architecture, processors, and hardware design
- [IEEE Internet Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/ic): internet-scale systems, protocols, and web technologies
- [IEEE Intelligent Systems](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/ex): applied artificial intelligence and intelligent systems
- [IEEE Computer Graphics and Applications](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/cg): graphics, visualization, and interactive techniques
- [Computing in Science & Engineering](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/cs): scientific computing, simulation, and computational methods
- [IEEE Pervasive Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/pc): mobile, ubiquitous, and context-aware computing
- [IEEE MultiMedia](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/mu): multimedia systems, content analysis, and applications
- [IT Professional](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/it): enterprise IT practice, infrastructure, and management
- [IEEE Annals of the History of Computing](https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/an): scholarship on the history of computing

## Conferences

- [Conferences](https://www.computer.org/conferences): conferences sponsored and co-sponsored by the Society
- [Events calendar](https://www.computer.org/conferences/calendar): upcoming conferences and events by date
- [Calls for papers](https://www.computer.org/publications/author-resources/calls-for-papers): open calls; entries are dated by conference year

## Technical communities and chapters

- [Technical communities](https://www.computer.org/communities): technical committees, councils, and special interest groups
- [Find a chapter](https://www.computer.org/communities/find-a-chapter): searchable directory of local, student, and regional chapters
- [Early Career Speaker Program](https://www.computer.org/communities/early-career-speaker-program): speaker program for early-career members
- [Sister societies](https://www.computer.org/communities/sister-societies): partner computing societies worldwide

## Education and certification

- [Education](https://www.computer.org/education): professional development and training programs
- [Course catalog](https://www.computer.org/education/courses): available courses and enrollment
- [e-Learning and virtual live sessions](https://www.computer.org/education/e-learning): online and instructor-led remote training
- [Certifications](https://www.computer.org/education/certifications): professional certification programs and requirements
- [Bodies of knowledge](https://www.computer.org/education/bodies-of-knowledge): SWEBOK and related reference guides
- [SWEBOK Certificate Program](https://www.computer.org/education/swebok-certificate-program): certificate track based on the software engineering body of knowledge
- [Software engineering code of ethics](https://www.computer.org/education/code-of-ethics): the joint IEEE-CS/ACM code of ethics and professional practice

## Volunteering and awards

- [Volunteering](https://www.computer.org/volunteering): volunteer roles, committees, and governance
- [Awards and fellows](https://www.computer.org/volunteering/awards): the Society's technical and service awards
- [Award recipients](https://www.computer.org/volunteering/awards/award-recipients): biographies of award and fellow recipients

## Optional

- [Press room](https://www.computer.org/press-room): press releases and announcements, dated
- [Advertising and sponsorship](https://www.computer.org/advertising-and-sponsorship-opportunities): media kit, digital advertising, and conference sponsorship
- [Careers](https://careers.computer.org/): the Society's computing job board
- [Sitemap index](https://www.computer.org/sitemap_index.xml): complete machine-readable list of all site URLs
